name: FriendChipsTech
rootCause: The FriendChipsTech token on ETH was suspected to be a rug pull, resulting in a loss of ~$77.5K. The exploiter created a malicious contract (0x1dB0B6012D64452ED6aa98e87F7c308DB0281E40) to mint tokens and dump them for ~$77.5K which has already been deposited to Tornado Cash.
